plans.text: Try Coin Collector's Assistant for coins and Discogs for records.
Research and verify the authenticity and value of the 1940s-era Leica IIIa and 1960s-era Nikon F cameras.
Get the 1913 Liberty Head nickel appraised.
Organize the pre-1920 American coins by denomination and mint mark and display the collection together.
Get some error coins authenticated, especially the recently bought 1972 doubled die cent.
Look into PCGS and NGC submission guidelines and get the 1972 doubled die cent authenticated soon.
Check those resources for upcoming coin shows in the user's area, meet other collectors, and learn more about error coins.
Find good deals on vintage cameras at coin shows to add to the camera collection.
Expand the camera collection with vintage rangefinders and keep an eye out for notable models and brands.
